 Hat-trick last time out against Al Kholood took Al Nassr captain to 985 career goals
 The countdown to 1,000 career goals is very much alive for Cristiano Ronaldo, who returns to Roshn Saudi League action this weekend 15 goals shy of the magical milestone.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement For the first time, he does so when not coming off international duty, having recently called time on his decorated career with his native Portugal .
 The knock-on effect for Al Nassr, then, should be that their captain's body has been given sufficient rest to focus on this season's ambitions for the RSL champions.
 With his hat-trick against Al Kholood taking him to eight goals in 10 league games this season, Ronaldo's scoring record is on par with that of the past two seasons in which he has netted 25 and 28 times, respectively.
 So, with five RSL outings remaining before the curtain closes on 2026, just how close will Ronaldo be by the time Al Nassr face league leaders, and arch rivals, Al Hilal in the Capital Derby on New Year's Day 2027?
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement We take a look at that quintet of fixtures and Ronaldo's scoring record against each opponent.
 --------
 Al Ahli (A) - Friday, November 20
 The first assignment for Ronaldo and Al Nassr after the international window is a heavyweight clash against Al Ahli in Jeddah on Friday night, with Al Ahli still reeling from their 6-1 thumping at the hands of Al Shabab .
 But don't automatically assume that will equal goals for Ronaldo.
 Despite their patchy form, Al Ahli are undefeated at home this campaign and have conceded only twice there. Ronaldo, meanwhile, has scored once in three games in Jeddah against Al Ahli - a winning penalty back in 2024.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While he has four goals in six games against the back-to-back Asian champions , three of those have come at his Al Awwal Park.
 Al Nassr's Cristiano Ronaldo at Al Ahli
 --------
 Al Hazem (A) - Saturday, November 28
 This might represent Ronaldo's best chance in this run of games to close 2026 to add goals to his career tally - and not just because of Al Hazem's struggles this season in which they've conceded 20 times in 12 matches.
 The Portuguese superstar has been prolific against the Ar Rass team since arriving in the Kingdom, with four goals in three appearances at a rate of 1.33 per game - his highest ratio against any of his next five opponents.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement With Al Nassr's rampant attack, this would be a game they would expect to create plenty of chances - Joao Felix has been at his creative best this term - and that could set the scene for a big night for Ronaldo.
 Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates Al Nassr's win at Al Hazem
 --------
 Al Qadsiah (H) - Friday, December 4
 On paper, this looks to be the most difficult game for both Ronaldo and Al Nassr.
 A Tijjani Reojnders-inspired Al Qadsiah have established themselves as genuine title contenders and possess one of the best defensive records in the league, conceding only one more than Al Nassr this season (12 goals).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement And, with only two goals in four games against the side from Al Khobar, a rate of 0.50 goals per game is Ronaldo's lowest against the five teams in this run.
 There's also the possibility, too, of directly facing Nacho, his old Real Madrid teammate .
 Aside from the great one's personal ambitions, this match promises to be crucial in the title race and, thus, the season-long aspirations for both clubs.
 Mark this one in your calendars.
 Former Real Madrid teammates, Al Qadsiah captain Nacho and Al Nassr counterpart Cristiano Ronaldo
 --------
 Al Shabab (H) - Saturday, December 12
 This looked a decidedly different fixture a little over a month ago when Al Shabab were winless and appeared destined for another relegation battle.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement But Thomas Letsch's side have turned around their form and, after a 6-1 win against Al Ahli right before the international break, are flying high on confidence.
 Al Shabab's defensive record is decent too - only 15 goals conceded, despite their patchy start - so this one won't be easy for the RSL title-holders.
 However, Ronaldo boasts a good record against his capital opponents, with seven goals in seven matches.
 So he will be even more full of his typical self-belief heading into this one that he can add another goal on the road to 1,000.
 Cristiano Ronaldo scores Al Nassr's third at Al Shabab to move to 100 RSL goals
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Al Fayha (A) - Wednesday, December 16
 Ronaldo and Al Nassr's final RSL fixture for 2026 comes on the road against Al Fayha.
 And, while he has a decent scoring record against them - four goals in six games - three of those have come at home, with only one notched at Al Majma'ah Sports City, where this clash will take place.
 Despite their superb 4-1 win against Al Faisaly in the Sudair Derby last time out, Al Fayha have been porous defensively this season, conceding 20 times in 12 games.
 With that in mind, Al Nassr will be confident of goals, which should again create opportunities for Ronaldo. Will he sign off the calendar year with a trademark bang?
